name: Kolgrim
title: Master of the Hunt
examine: Forty winters of wind on one face. He counts everything: arrows, tracks, favors, and the exact number of times you have wasted his morning.
lines: Wind first. Ground second. Shot last.
The hunt owes the fold first. What is left over is yours to brag on.
Sunn reads snow better than I ever did. Tell her and I will deny it.
